newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks drift down in quiet London trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks drift down in quiet London trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks drifted lower in lifeless trade on Wednesday, with investors reluctant to take new positions ahead of the holiday period, dealers said.
By 1504 GMT the Nikkei 50 index was down 19.48 points at 1425.49, after the Nikkei 225 average in Tokyo ended down 320.43 points at 20,093.03, just above the crucial 20,000 level.
"I'd say it was 50/50 whether the Nikkei will stay above or below that 20,000 level," one dealer said.
"The market's in Christmas mode, there are no buyers at the moment and I'd be surprised if people stick their necks out on positions before they go off on holiday."
